trust_decision.summary: Whether a client-supplied xsd:anyURI DSML value is dereferenced (fetched) by the gateway server-side, and if so which schemes/hosts/sizes are allowed; decided only in ByteStringUtility.convertValue, which at the pinned commit fetches any URI with no gate, scheme check, host check or size cap.

landing_point.why: The only URI fetch in the DSML module (toURL().openStream() on a DSML value); a grep for anyURI/openStream lands here immediately.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST /DSMLServlet (SOAP batchRequest: addRequest, modifyRequest, compareRequest, searchRequest filter, extendedRequest)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared value-conversion helper (same package as handlers)

fix_sites.entry_point: deployment descriptor for /DSMLServlet (adds security-constraint / BASIC auth)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Search-filter and extended-request values are not 'adds and modifies' (the pinned comment at opendj-dsml-servlet/src/main/java/org/opends/dsml/protocol/DSMLServlet.java:193 says anyURI is for adds and modifies), but all of them call the same helper, so fixing the helper closes them together.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Plain string, base64Binary (byte[]) and DOM Element DSML values must still convert normally; an anyURI value must still be accepted and stored (published choice: stored verbatim as its string) rather than making the whole add/modify fail.

O6_input_shapes: http/https URI to loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT, reserved and IPv6 ULA addresses (IP literal or hostname)
http URI to a public host that answers with a 3xx redirect
other schemes: ftp, gopher, jar:http, opaque urn:, scheme-less relative URI
anyURI value inside attr value lists (add/modify), compare assertion, search filter (equality, substrings initial/any/final, ge/le/approx, extensible match), extended requestValue

O7_producer.where: opendj-dsml-servlet/src/main/java/org/opends/dsml/protocol/DSMLServlet.java:194 (mapAnyUriToUri makes JAXB unmarshalling at DSMLServlet.java:474-476 materialise xsi:type anyURI values as java.net.URI)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An extended-operation-specific requestValue decoder that resolves a URI itself (own openStream) instead of calling convertValue.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: requestValue is xsd:anyType (opendj-dsml-servlet/resources/schema/DSMLv2.xsd:447), so a maintainer adding typed handling for a specific OID could plausibly write a separate resolver.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Control-value conversion (controlValue is xsd:anyType and is currently ignored by the servlet) implemented with its own URI dereference.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Controls are unimplemented in the gateway; adding them would need a value converter, and a copy of the old fetch loop is the obvious shortcut.

O9_family: SSRF / external resource reference (CWE-918, CWE-73) with unbounded read (CWE-400)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module (pom.xml:44-45); dsml-servlet depends on opendj-server-legacy, opendj-core, opendj-config, JAXB/JAX-WS RI (opendj-dsml-servlet/pom.xml:62-99)
O10_build.project_tests: None for the DSML module at the pinned commit (no opendj-dsml-servlet/src/test); the fix adds a TestNG unit test ByteStringUtilityTestCase using IP literals and in-memory streams (fix.diff:471-727).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a scheme allowlist (http/https only) to convertValue and keep fetching, leaving redirects followed, private/metadata hosts reachable and the read uncapped.

out_of_scope_notes: LDIF readers dereference URL values (opendj-core/src/main/java/org/forgerock/opendj/ldif/AbstractLDIFReader.java:283, opendj-server-legacy/src/main/java/org/opends/server/util/LDIFReader.java:1423); admin/tool LDIF input, not the DSML gateway, not pursued.
unverified: All 5 DSML request kinds route through ByteStringUtility.convertValue (callers: DSMLAddOperation.java:93, DSMLModifyOperation.java:107, DSMLCompareOperation.java:84, DSMLSearchOperation.java:114,133,152,174,194,285,295,298, DSMLExtendedOperation.java:104), so O1 counts request kinds on one HTTP route; the whole fix is in effect a single helper and every 'route' is where-type.
single_site is borderline: the fix also touches DSMLServlet.init and web.xml, but the security logic is one function and no O2/O8 route was found.

How-type room is limited to a single function: redirect following (HttpURLConnection follows by default), jar: wrapping, host classification, size cap. The size cap is resource exhaustion, which has never made a task hard.

Hidden-test fairness: the published tests call new package-private helpers (convertUri, assertHostAllowed, isInternalAddress, readCapped, setDereferenceUri); behavioural tests would have to go through convertValue only, and the 'stored verbatim by default' outcome is a design choice a solver might reasonably replace with rejection.
Repo size not measured (no shell used); presence in latest code unknown (no latest release given).
Whether JAXB RI actually honours the mapAnyUriToUri system property was not traced into the dependency.
